items.definition:
a complete transformation or renovation
The old house got a complete makeover.

a written message in business or diplomacy
The manager sent a memorandum to all staff regarding the new policy.

the avoidance of excess or extremes
Everything in moderation, including moderation.

Non-Governmental Organization
Many NGOs are working to provide aid in disaster zones.

the quality of being noble in character; the class of nobles
He showed great nobility in his actions.

a system of symbols or abbreviations used to represent quantities or qualities
Musical notation helps musicians read and play songs.

a very unpleasant and prolonged experience
The long journey was a terrible ordeal.

a sliding piece inside the cylinder of an engine, which is moved by pressure
The engine's piston moves up and down rapidly.

the period during which adolescents reach sexual maturity and become capable of reproduction
Puberty brings many changes to the body.

a county in Great Britain; a rural area
The Shire is a peaceful region in Middle-earth.

a long, narrow cut or opening
There was a small slit in the curtain.

a social prohibition
In some cultures, it's a taboo to discuss money.

a short promotional clip
The movie studio released a new teaser trailer.

unimportant facts or details
He knows a lot of useless trivia.

a person who travels aimlessly
He was a wanderer, never staying in one place for long.

a person who breeds animals
She is a dog breeder.

a dark reddish-purple color
She wore a dress in a rich burgundy color.

a person or thing that changes something
He was a game changer in the industry.

the state of being restricted within an area or space
The prisoner was held in solitary confinement.

a company that gives expert advice on a particular subject
She works for a management consultancy firm.

the process of becoming smaller; a shortened form of a word
The word 'don't' is a contraction of 'do not'.

the process of reaching a conclusion by reasoning; an amount subtracted
His deduction was based on careful observation.

a statement that denies something, especially responsibility
The website included a legal disclaimer.

a judgment or opinion; an approximate calculation
The project's cost estimation was accurate.

the action of digging something out of the ground
The archaeological excavation revealed ancient artifacts.

a wreath of flowers or leaves
She wore a garland of fresh flowers in her hair.

a thing that is eagerly pursued or sought after
Finding a cure for cancer is the holy grail of medical research.

the state of being holy
The priest spoke about the concept of holiness.

a lack of balance or symmetry; disproportion
There is a significant imbalance between supply and demand.

a member of a jury
Each juror had to listen carefully to the evidence presented.

the number of people available for work or service
The project requires more manpower to be completed on time.

a person who resides or is present in a house, vehicle, seat, place, etc., at a given time
The previous occupant of this apartment left some furniture behind.

the period of time after the regular season in a sport
The team hopes to make it to the postseason this year.

an object surviving from an earlier time, especially one of historical or sentimental interest
The old sword was a relic from ancient times.

a large snake
The ancient story tells of a giant serpent.

a device that makes a loud, wailing sound as a signal or warning; a mythical creature
We heard the siren of an ambulance.

a person who is sleeping; something that achieves unexpected success
The movie was a sleeper hit.

a dirty mark or smudge; a false accusation
There was a smear of mud on his cheek.

status or reputation; a position in a competition
He has a high standing in the community.

a committee formed from a larger committee
The bill was sent to a special subcommittee.

a sharp blow or slap
He gave the fly a quick swat.

the use of symbols to represent ideas or qualities
The symbolism in the painting was very deep.

alcohol addiction
Alcoholism is a serious disease that affects many families.

device that increases sound
He connected his guitar to the amplifier to make it louder.

recipient of benefits
She was named the sole beneficiary of her uncle's will.

a feeling of anger or resentment
He felt a deep bitterness towards his former business partner.

a spoiled or ill-behaved child
The little brat refused to share his toys with anyone.

a narrow bed, often stacked
The children slept in bunk beds during their camping trip.

a device for holding things tightly
He used a clamp to hold the two pieces of wood together while the glue dried.

the desire to be more successful than others
Her competitiveness drives her to always strive for excellence.

a statement that opposes another
There was a clear contradiction between his two statements.

the ceremony of crowning a monarch
The coronation of the new king was a grand event.

skill in deception
The fox used its cunning to outsmart the hunter.

a representation or description
The painting offered a vivid depiction of the battle.

disagreement; lack of harmony
There was much discord among the committee members.

the ability to withstand wear, pressure, or damage
The durability of this material makes it ideal for outdoor furniture.

a death caused by an accident or disaster
There were no fatalities reported in the plane crash.

the process of making oneself neat and tidy; preparing someone for a role; illicitly preparing someone for sexual abuse
The dog requires regular grooming to keep its coat healthy.

central stone in an arch; fundamental part
Trust is the keystone of any strong relationship.

praise and honor received for an achievement
Kudos to the team for a job well done!

violent or damaging disorder; chaos
The sudden storm caused absolute mayhem in the city.

the most successful point; the culmination
Reaching the summit was the pinnacle of his climbing career.

pounds per square inch (unit of pressure)
The tire pressure should be 32 psi.

a performance or interpretation, especially of a musical piece or dramatic role
Her rendition of the song was truly beautiful.
